# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old by the end of Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v3 c27 P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v3 c37 P39](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0039)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farm manager  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Thirza  <sub>[v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P12](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, slender woman with sharp angles rather than curves. She has dark hair with graying strands that she binds at the back in a tight, firm bun held combatively by wire hairpins. Over the years, her sallow face acquires a gentler expression, though she retains her lean figure and sharp contours.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v3 c33 P15](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0015)_

## Personality

Thirza possesses an unyielding sense of morality, a strict commitment to propriety, and an agonizingly immaculate sense of household cleanliness. Although she is sharp, abrupt, and deeply skeptical of foolishness or imaginative 'fancies,' she harbors a redeemed sense of humor and a hidden capacity for profound, quiet affection. Though she finds it difficult to express her deepest feelings verbally, her devotion to her home and family is unwavering.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v3 c30 P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003)_

- Painstakingly clean and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 c7 P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014)</sub>

- Expert homemaking and housekeeping  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- To maintain proper order and morality at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c7 P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014)</sub>
- To raise Nell Harcourt into a proper, dutiful, and practical young woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>
- To preserve Grey Shutters as a family home  <sub>[v3 c38 P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 c38 P28](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0028)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy resides at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her quiet brother, Obed. Expecting an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist with farm work, they are shocked when an imaginative, red-haired girl named Nell Harcourt arrives due to a communication mistake. Though initially intending to return Nell or place her elsewhere, Thirza relents and agrees to adopt her. Thirza takes on the responsibility of raising and disciplining the talkative child, training her in practical duties while privately growing deeply attached to her. When Obed dies suddenly after the failure of the Abbey Bank, Thirza is left heartbroken and facing financial strain. Nell decides to forgo a college scholarship to stay at Grey Shutters and teach locally to support Thirza. Later, Thirza develops eye trouble that threatens her sight, leading her to invite the newly widowed Agatha Sowerby to live at Grey Shutters so Nell can finally attend Wexcombe College. Thirza also takes in two orphaned third cousins, the twins Robin and Lucy Farrow, raising them alongside Agatha. Eventually, Thirza sees Nell graduate, qualify as a teacher, and marry Hugh Carrow, the son of her own former suitor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v2 c7 P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c26 P16](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0016), [v2 c26 P22](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0022), [v3 c37 P37](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0037), [v3 c38 P4](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0004), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Brierley in a strict household  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c10 P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)</sub>
- Overheard an aunt comment on her dark, homely appearance during childhood  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Had a youthful courtship with John Carrow that ended after an argument she refused to forgive  <sub>[v3 c37 P37](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0037), [v3 c37 P40](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Lived as a spinster at Grey Shutters alongside her brother Obed  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>

> Agatha, it was wrong of you to mock her appearance.  <sub>[v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026)</sub>
